semantic_checks: head_inheritance: Only change is parenthesising {account}, matching English and the updated context note; device/account placeholders preserved; 'use, not copy' meaning unchanged.
file_key_disclosure: Present/habitual signing with a key file, not Touch ID, hence no proof a person approved the request; makes no claim the waiting/refused request was already signed (context).
file_key_recorded: Past tense: this approval WAS signed with a key file, not Touch ID; cannot prove a person approved it. Tense distinction from file_key_disclosure kept.
technical_request: Label for the collapsed technical disclosure of the exact signed request; 'technical' qualifier kept.

needs_attention / shared_count / shared / result_status: Counts name credential shares and items needing attention, not device connections; both numeric placeholders preserved with ::group-off; result_status uses the same terms as the visible labels.

duration_* / answer_window: Bare request-answer durations with locale plural categories (case inflected where the only consumer, answer_window, governs it); answer_window states a deadline to answer THIS request, never how long access lasts.
cancel_sharing / cancel_hint: Cancel stops this pending request and explicitly does NOT withdraw/revoke access already shared; not rendered as deny or revoke.
signing_applying: Neutral progress for sign-and-apply; no Touch ID prompt promised.
retry_hint: Names the Try again button with the same words as ui.mesh.approval.try_again and says it applies this already-approved request.
named_refusal: Attributes the verbatim backend reason to the named request; {request} and {reason} preserved.

Security-consent equivalence: no changed value reverses, omits or widens a consent consequence; share scope, answer-window-vs-share-lifetime and cancel-vs-deny/revoke semantics match English exactly in this locale.
